parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic. It is a long, narrow component attached to the frame.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the user's ear and helps maintain stability when worn.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the user's head, ensuring the glasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or open outward, similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, consisting of the frame that holds the lenses and connects to the legs.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position for vision correction or protection and connects to the legs for support.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central structure to which the legs are hinged.
